coaching.headline: Shinbi finished 10-0 and closed it personally, killing three of ours alone in the final fight at 25.8, after an offlane caught out three times before minute 14. Towers finished one to their seven.
coaching.team: The draft left one favored lane on paper, Kira's carry matchup, with the other four read as theirs. It played out through the offlane first: Legion was caught alone three times between 9 and 13.1, and the second and third catches each had an outer tower fall on the timer. The middle of the game was genuinely ours. The fight at 13.8 at their outer tower was won 3-1, and we cashed it into Fangtooth at 15. The river fight at 16.7 was lost 0-5, but that loss bought the Mini Prime across the map at 19. Both fights we won, we cashed, 2 for 2, including Yin's outnumbered 2-0 over Dekker and Lt. Belica at their inhibitor at 23.6. What killed us was starting fights while a death timer was running. The fight at our own Mini Prime at 19.3 opened 4v5 with Zinx down 32 seconds and was lost 1-3. Fangtooth and the inner tower both fell at 20.4 behind it. The 2v2 at their inner tower at 22.9 was the wrong fight, taken with Legion and Yin alive but pinned across the map. Our inner tower fell at 23.2 and the inhibitor at 23.5. The final fight at 25.8 was started with Renna down 37 seconds and lost 0-3, and the Core fell at 26.2. Next game, one rule: while a teammate's death timer runs, we do not start fights. Hold, reset, and take the next one 5v5.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: What made the fight at our own Mini Prime at 19.3 unwinnable? It opened 4v5, Zinx having gone down 32 seconds earlier, with Kira alive, ahead in lane, and absent. It was lost 1-3, and Fangtooth and the inner tower both fell at 20.4. That flipped a window where we had just taken Fangtooth and Mini Prime into their game-ending push.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 was caught alone three times in five minutes. Shinbi got him at 9 and again at 13.1. Scarlett took the one in between at 11.1. Two of those catches ended with outer towers falling, at 12.4 and 13.9. Offlane is graded on survival because every one of those death timers opened the river, and it ran 15 buffs to 7 theirs. The 20,665 damage dealt shows the fights were there once alive. Vanquisher, the missing piece of the 56.9% Malady, Vanquisher and Deathstalker core, never came.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 held the only lane we had favored on paper, winning at every checkpoint, and the output was 2/2/1 with 13,099 damage. Kira was alive and ahead but absent from both the fight at our Mini Prime at 19.3 and the final fight at 25.8, with the entire 56.5% Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator core skipped. Winning the lane is half the job, and arriving with the lead is the half this game needed.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's map work held up: 13 wards placed, 3 cleared, 7,306 healed — the best vision numbers on the team. The one expensive minute was the catch by Eden at 18.8, which is exactly what made the Mini Prime defense at 19.3 a 4v5. On a losing map, no death hurts more than the support going down half a minute before the objective fight.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim produced the best moment of the game, the fight at their inhibitor at 23.6, won 2-0 into Dekker and Lt. Belica while down a body, and the team went 2-for-2 cashing the fights it won. The caveats: two completed items in 26 minutes, with Lightning Hawk and Onixian Quiver missing from the 54.2% core, and no magic resist into a three-magical comp while taking 38,018 damage. The death at 19.3 was also followed by Fangtooth and the inner tower falling at 20.4.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs built the only complete winning core on the team, the 57.5% Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer set, and traded evenly at 4/4 in a mid that tilted against us late on paper. But Xeebs placed 1 ward in 26 minutes, and the solo death to Shinbi at 25.2 made the last stand a 4v5. The Core fell at 26.2.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Caught alone three times before minute 14, and two outer towers fell on those death timers, at 12.4 and 13.9. Those timers opened the river, and it ran 15 buffs to 7 against us.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: The one favored lane on paper produced 2/2/1 and was absent from both fights that ended the game, at 19.3 and 25.8. The lead stayed in the lane instead of turning into towers.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: 13 wards, 3 cleared, 7,306 healed — the support work held up on a night the rest of the map didn't.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: The fight at their inhibitor at 23.6, won 2-0 while outnumbered, and a perfect 2-for-2 cashing won fights — the right map, played on two items.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: One ward in 26 minutes from the rotation lane, and the solo death at 25.2 to a 10-0 Shinbi put the Core on the clock at 26.2 — discipline, not the build, was the gap.

coaching.whatWorked: Both won fights were cashed inside the window. The win at 13.8 at their outer tower turned into Fangtooth at 15. The outnumbered win at their inhibitor at 23.6 was cashed the same way, 2 of 2 converted. In a game this uphill, the convert-every-win habit never broke.

16.7.call: That loss at their river bought Mini Prime across the map, but a trade does not need five bodies standing in it. With the prize coming cross-map, the job was to disengage and leave with it. Staying to flip a full fight turned the trade into five death timers.

25.8.call: With Renna's timer running from the catch at 25.2, no fight was worth starting. The only play left was four together under a structure, conceding ground until the fifth was back on the map. Starting anything a body down at that stage handed Shinbi the ending.

19.3.call: The objective was in hand, and leaving with it was the play. A body down, with the support's timer running, staying to fight is exactly what the numbers punish. Take the prize, give the ground, and regroup five-strong for the Fangtooth spawn.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Mr_Meat31 had two of Legion's three core items: Malady's stacking on-hit damage and Deathstalker's armor shred with attack speed. The missing one was Vanquisher, whose execute converts whittled-down enemies into kills, part of why Legion finished 0 kills to 6 deaths on 20,665 hero damage: the hurt was real, the finish was not. The wider issue was the lineup read: Shinbi's 25k magical was the enemy's biggest output and nobody on the team, Legion included, bought magic resist; caught alone three times before minute 14, he was fighting the game's main threat with zero mitigation against her damage type.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis backs Legion's attack rhythm: sustained basic attacks on one target trigger repeating max-health damage, which pairs naturally with Malady's stacking hits. Serration adds missing-health damage to close out targets, the same finishing job the skipped Vanquisher does through items. It trades toughness for pressure; against Shinbi's burst-and-leave pattern the ramp resets constantly, so the loadout pays best when Legion forces her to stand and fight.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Goldilocks324 took the projectile route on Kira: Vanquisher for crit and an execute, then Scattershot and Onixian Quiver to multiply arrows. The winning core does something different: Imperator makes each critical strike hit harder and Ashbringer refunds cooldowns on-hit, so the ultimate returns fight after fight. In a 26-minute game that never let her scale past three items, 13,099 hero damage was the quiet result; the crit-multiplier core front-loads more of its power into exactly these mid-game fights.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis mirrors the Eden matchup itself: both carries ramp on basic attacks, and the every-third-hit max-health bite means Kira wins the stand-and-shoot war if both commit. Serration and Melting Point extend that edge to low targets and armored ones. The trade-off is that it offers zero help disengaging; the pre-game read said to pressure Eden early, and this loadout only rewards that pressure if Kira keeps attacking through the danger.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Cuban Noobster's Zinx went utility: Dynamo makes crowd-controlled targets take extra damage, and Lunaria converts her damage into heals that jump to the lowest-health ally, a real fit for the team's only healer. The winning core is a different animal, an on-hit build of Prophecy, Spectra, and Orion that turns her attack spam into a second damage source. The version she ran was coherent; the flag that stung was defensive, no magic resist on her or anyone else against a three-magical lineup, so her 7,306 health healed had to outpace damage nobody blunted.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Exarch is made for a healing Zinx: every heal or shield she lands speeds up the target's attacks and adds sting to them, turning her sustain into a damage boost for the carry. Revelation refunds a slice of cooldown on every cast, and her kit casts constantly, while Fervour makes her own attacks drip healing to nearby allies. The cost is personal: nothing in it protects Zinx herself, so it assumes she stays behind the fight she is fueling.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Willy Guggenheim's Yin got Sky Splitter, the anchor of her core, whose on-hit current-health shred plus lifesteal explains much of her 16,537 health healed. Storm Breaker's chaining lightning was the off-script pick over Lightning Hawk and Onixian Quiver, which bring a slowing empowered shot and a burst of attack speed with extra projectiles, the pieces that make her volleys land more often and harder. Two finished items in 26 minutes was the deeper limit; with no magic resist into a three-magical lineup, 38,018 damage taken came with nothing to soften it.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vermis rewards Yin's tempo: fast repeated hits on one target keep the every-third-attack max-health damage cycling, and Melting Point stops the enemy frontline from walling her out. Serration adds a finisher's edge on low targets. It gives up defense and burst entirely, which matters on a jungler who has to dive to reach targets; the loadout is all payoff for time-on-target and nothing for the trip in or out.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xeebs hit Renna's winning core exactly: Entropy for haste and extra damage on every ability hit, Wraith Leggings for magic penetration, and Overseer, which amplifies her damage and heals her back a share of it. That last mechanic is the build's engine: it lets Renna trade in lane and leave with the health she spent, which matched the pre-game plan of forcing early trades on Lt. Belica before her core completed. Nothing to fix here; the three-item core did its job with four kills before the game got away from us.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh compounds what Renna already does: every ability that lands leaves a burn, and her long-range casts land often. The Tenth Seal boosts her level-10 ultimate and Mind Rot lets the burn wound tankier targets her raw magic damage bounces off. It trades away any survivability help, a real consideration against a Belica who executes anyone lingering at low health; the loadout wants her poking from range, never brawling.

amps.name: Tainted Scepter
amps.how: Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.

amps.name: Oathkeeper
amps.how: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 65 (+35%) Damage On-Hit.

amps.name: Tempest
amps.how: Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.

amps.name: Vesh
amps.how: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 17.4% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

amps.name: Mind Rot
amps.how: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.

lead.title: Hard to kill
lead.text: Never died in 26 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Shinbi offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.

eden.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Focal Lens, crest Liberator
ultPlus: Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
lines: Ashbringer (Chrono Strikes): On Successful Basic Attack: Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.• Only triggers once per ability.• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.
Eden dealt 15,970 hero damage, 18% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Zinx (level 15 estimated: about 122 physical armor, 110 after penetration) and Yin (level 15 estimated: about 83 physical armor, 71 after penetration) that is about 6% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 2,052 healing recorded.
